[Wesco International](https://www.wesco.com/us/en.html) is a Fortune 500 business-to-business distributor and supply chain solutions provider. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, the publicly traded company specializes in electrical, industrial, and communications maintenance products, managing logistics and inventory services for over 150,000 active customers worldwide. [](https://www.wesco.com/us/en/our-company.html)

- **Electrical and Electronic Solutions:** Supplies wiring, cables, lighting, automation devices, and general safety or repair items.

- **Communications and Security Solutions:** Provides data center infrastructure, network systems, professional audio/visual gear, and security integration products.

- **Utility and Broadband Solutions:** Delivers products like transformers, power cables, and transmission hardware to power utilities and broadband operators

### Company Profile

- **Founded:** 1922 (as part of Westinghouse Electric, later spun off)

- **Headquarters:** Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA

- **Employees:** ~21,000

- **Global Reach:** Operations in roughly 50 countries with hundreds of branches and distribution centers [](https://buy.wesco.com/about-us/company-profile)
